title: SAP API Management API Proxy Structure
description: Structure documentation for SAP API Management API Proxy entities

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unique proxy name used as identifier in URLs and references

fields.name: title
fields.description: Human-readable display title shown in the developer portal

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the proxy's backend service and purpose
fields.example: Manages purchase orders in SAP S/4HANA

fields.name: basepath
fields.description: URL base path for routing to this proxy on the API gateway

fields.name: apiProviderId
fields.description: Reference to the registered API provider (backend system)
